objective: Replace the reach-only harvest approach with one deterministic, cancellable and permission-bounded path to a loaded nearby allowlisted log, then equip a fixed-priority axe or empty hand, dig exactly once and verify the exact target disappeared.
non_goals: Do not let the model, renderer, HTTP caller or viewer choose coordinates, routes, movement primitives, tools, Mineflayer methods, code or action sequences.
Do not let pathfinding dig, place blocks, scaffold, tower, open doors, sprint, parkour, enter liquids, retry, explore unloaded chunks or continue after emergency stop.
Do not add crafting, recipe lookup, collection loops, combat, food use, storage, background autonomy, public authority, widget authority or manual gameplay controls.
contracts: The text model can return only harvest.nearby-log.v3 or unsupported; the controller alone selects one loaded log from the fixed block allowlist.
The pathfinder uses one fixed GoalLookAtBlock and repository-owned movement policy with no block mutation, unsafe traversal or retries; disconnect, timeout and emergency stop cancel the active route.

After navigation the controller re-reads physics freshness, on-ground state and exact target diggability, selects only the fixed-priority owned axe or empty hand, digs once and reports success only when the exact target is absent.
Every typed boundary rejects retired v1/v2 goals, arbitrary arguments, coordinates, routes and generated action plans.
allowed_dependencies: mineflayer-pathfinder 2.4.5, MIT, exact npm dependency used only for one bounded controller-owned A* route to visible digging range.
oss_candidates: PrismarineJS/mineflayer-pathfinder: exact runtime dependency at npm 2.4.5 / ca35a00ec18e7d3095280ffe2dc194e7c81b55eb; no upstream source copied.
acceptance_criteria: A loaded allowlisted log up to 32 horizontal and eight vertical blocks away can be approached through one bounded path and harvested exactly once.
No route, stale state, changed target, timeout, disconnect or emergency stop fails closed before the dig or aborts the active operation and clears controls.
Pathfinder placement/digging/scaffolding/towering/doors/sprinting/parkour/liquid traversal are disabled and the search radius is bounded to 40 blocks.
Desktop trace tells the owner that bounded A* is running and preserves the exact stable controller error or postcondition result.

latency_or_quality_budget.path_search: one attempt; 40-block A* search radius; 5,000 ms planning budget per search; 30,000 ms total controller deadline
latency_or_quality_budget.target_scope: one loaded allowlisted log within 32 horizontal and eight vertical blocks
latency_or_quality_budget.side_effect: at most one exact log dig; no pathfinder block mutation or retry
